title: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION
text: The substate 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION is chosen in the UE if the initial registration procedure failed due to a missing response from the network or due to the circumstances described in subclauses5.5.1.2.4, 5.5.1.2.5, 5.5.1.2.7 and 5.5.1.3.4
